subject: The secret feature I almost didn't release
preview_text: I was going to keep this one quiet, but you deserve to know what's coming next for your pup.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I've been holding something back from you. It's the one feature that could completely change how you see your dog's progress, and I almost scrapped it because it felt too personal, too revealing.

You know that feeling when you're doing everything right—measuring meals, tracking walks—but you still can't quite picture the finish line? The vet-approved guidelines and calorie math are solid, but sometimes you need more than numbers. You need to feel the win before it happens. That's what this is about.

Next month, we're launching a 3D body visualization tool. You'll upload a photo of your dog, and the app will show you a projected 'after' image based on their current weight loss trajectory. It uses the same breed-specific data as our meal plans to create a realistic preview of their healthier future body. You'll see the change before it's fully visible in real life.

Want to be among the first to try it? The beta test starts soon for active users. Open the app and update your dog's current photos in the timeline section. That way, when the feature drops, you're ready to go. P.S. This is the exact tool that helped my own dog, Bruno, stay motivated when his weight loss plateaued—seeing that visual proof kept us both going.
